invariants.rationale: It is likely that idPfx, representing an identifier prefix, should not be null at method entry.
The Iterator for records being inserted should not be null for the method to proceed correctly.
recordItr is an Iterator, not a List, so this invariant captures its semantics at entry.
If idPfx is used as a partition or prefix, it likely should be non-empty for inserts.
If the iterator has a next element, the next record should not be null to ensure data consistency.
